title: Effects of carbon nanotube and curing agent concentrations on the mechanical, thermal and electrical properties of polydimethylsiloxane: optimization and statistical analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14838-14847
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01890K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Waham Ashaier Laftah, Wan Aizan Wan Abdul Rahman, Akos Noel Ibrahim
This study explores the effect of carbon nanotubes and curing agents on the mechanical, thermal, and electrical properties of PDMS, using statistical analysis to optimize tensile strength, elasticity, and conductivity.
